findings.title: Malformed debug-grant structures can escape the typed Meta failure contract
findings.rationale:
Issue card.

Evidence: `api-app/src/integrations/meta/meta.client.ts:93-104` spreads `data.scopes` and calls `.map` on `data.granular_scopes` after unchecked casts. A provider response whose parsed root is valid JSON object but whose `data.scopes` is an object, whose `granular_scopes` is non-array/null-containing, or whose target list is malformed can throw raw `TypeError`. `api-app/src/domain/channels/channels.service.ts:288-295` maps only `MetaIndisponivelError` to the fixed 503, so this provider-shape failure becomes generic 500 instead. Current tests cover a structurally valid grant with wrong values at `meta.client.spec.ts:164-172` and malformed phone pages at `:175-203`; neither exercises the grant-shape branch. The new root non-record guard at `meta.client.ts:209-216` also lacks a direct array/null/primitive response case.

Why now: cp36f expressly claims fail-closed handling for malformed successful provider data and selective safe BFF mapping. This is the remaining untyped external-data path in that verification flow.

Options:
A. Do nothing — effort none; risk medium; blast radius is official administrative verification; maintenance burden remains hidden schema assumptions; performance unchanged; elegance/structural soundness regress because equivalent provider data is classified inconsistently.
B. Add only tests — effort low; risk low; exposes the defect but intentionally leaves the safe-error contract broken; performance unchanged; not sufficient for checkpoint acceptance.
C. Recommended: validate grant fields before iteration, convert malformed grant structures to `MetaIndisponivelError`, and add table-driven unit cases plus one BFF representative proving fixed 503/no state mutation/lease release — small-to-medium effort; bounded adapter/BFF blast radius; negligible performance impact; restores a single coherent external-schema boundary and durable regression protection.
findings.suggested_action: Do not mutate this frozen source in this audit. In the corrective lane, normalize and validate debug-grant `data`, `scopes`, `granular_scopes`, granular entries, and target IDs before use; reject malformed structures with the typed safe error. Add fail-first adapter cases for non-record JSON roots and malformed grant shapes, then a representative real-adapter-through-BFF case asserting META_INDISPONIVEL, fixed public text, unchanged channel/attempt/credential/identity/receipt/audit state, and released lease.
